home_id.reason: Entity identifier. May be used for joins, duplicate detection, grouping, and auditing, but not as a predictive feature.

community.reason: Project location attribute expected to be established by construction start.

metro.reason: Project location attribute expected to be established by construction start.

permit_authority.reason: Permit jurisdiction should be established before construction begins.

lot_number.reason: Lot assignment exists before construction starts.

plan_name.reason: Building plan should be established before construction starts.

plan_code.reason: Building plan code should be established before construction starts.

product_line.reason: Product type should be established before construction starts.

beds.reason: Planned structural attribute available before construction begins.

baths.reason: Planned structural attribute available before construction begins.

half_baths.reason: Planned structural attribute available before construction begins.

sqft.reason: Planned house size should be available before construction begins.

stories.reason: Planned structural attribute available before construction begins.

garage_size.reason: Planned structural attribute available before construction begins.

basement_type.reason: Planned structural attribute expected to be determined before construction.

lot_type.reason: Lot characteristic exists before construction starts.

lot_size_sqft.reason: Lot characteristic exists before construction starts.

is_spec_home.reason: Project type should be known when construction begins.

selected_options_value.reason: May be known before construction starts, but could also change during construction. Do not use until the business process confirms the value is frozen at prediction time.

site_manager.reason: May be assigned before or at construction start, but assignment timing and possible reassignment should be confirmed.

sale_date.reason: Some homes may be sold before construction and others after construction begins. Availability at prediction time must be verified.

permit_application_date.reason: Permit application is expected to precede construction start.

permit_issue_date.reason: Historical deterministic checks show no permit issue dates occurring after construction start in this dataset.

construction_start_date.reason: This is the prediction timestamp itself. Calendar and seasonality features may be derived from it.

construction_end_date.reason: Future outcome information. Used to derive historical labels only. Never available as a predictor at construction start.

final_inspection_date.reason: Future outcome information occurring after construction begins.

change_order_count.reason: Historical total reflects events occurring during construction. Do not use unless a separate variable explicitly represents the count known at construction start.

trade_invoice_total.reason: Historical total accumulates from construction activity. Do not use unless a separate pre-construction estimate is documented.

data_source.reason: Metadata field. Current dataset contains only one observed value, so it carries no predictive variation here.

construction_status.reason: Useful for identifying completed versus in-progress observations, but must not be used as the cycle-time predictor at construction start.

validation.rationale: Temporal validation is appropriate because deployment concerns future construction starts.

structured_data.censoring_consideration: Incomplete homes with missing construction_end_date may represent right-censored construction durations. Completed-case regression is a possible candidate analysis, but excluding unfinished homes may introduce selection concerns. Survival analysis can be considered as a censoring-aware alternative, though the primary task remains continuous regression.
